propositions: Add an advisory LLM criterion that validates whether a ticket declaring no repository-file impact actually describes work requiring repository-file changes, activated only when persisted file_impact_scope is exactly 'none'
Extend the applies_at routing mechanism to support require_file_impact_scope filtering so the criterion is routed deterministically without cost for non-matching scopes
Carry the persisted no_file_impact_reason into Pass-1 requests as structured context with deterministic JSON serialization to preserve the declared reason in the LLM input

The criterion prompt must evaluate three sub-answer fields (assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named) and return advisory contradiction for named repository changes, advisory contradiction for documentation changes, or non-blocking coaching for insufficient grounding
Reading repository code without editing remains compatible with no-file-impact; documentation changes do not qualify as external-only
The criterion must be discoverable from front matter, registered in CANONICAL_LLM with packaged routing, and pass shared overlay validation with the new routing key
